title: Homology of a locally split short complex
statement: Let $Z$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $S=(M_1\xrightarrow f M_2\xrightarrow g M_3)$ be a short complex of $\mathcal O_Z$-modules, meaning $g\circ f=0$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and let $k,b\in\mathbb N$. Suppose $\ker g$ is finite locally free of rank $k$ and $\operatorname{im} f$ is finite locally free of rank $b$ [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. The image means the kernel of the cokernel map [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-module-cokernel-image]. Assume that every point $z\in Z$ has an open neighbourhood $U$ on which the inclusion $(\operatorname{im} f)|_U\to M_2|_U$ admits a retraction. Then $H(S)=\ker g/\operatorname{im} f$ is finite locally free of rank $k-b$, with natural subtraction.

proof.text: Around each point choose a neighbourhood admitting the image retraction, shrink to an affine open, and trivialize the finite locally free kernel and image. The identity g∘f=0 factors the image inclusion through ker g. Restrict the given retraction M₂→im f to ker g: its composite with im f→ker g is the identity. Thus im f is a direct summand of ker g.

On affine sections the quotient H=ker g/im f is the complementary direct summand of the finite free kernel. It is finitely generated, as a quotient of a finitely generated module, and projective by the direct-summand theorem [lem-weil-pbc-projective-direct-summand]. Apply the finite-projective standard-free-cover theorem [lem-weil-pbc-finite-projective-standard-free-cover] to refine to principal opens where H is finite free. At any residue field the split exact sequence 0→im f→ker g→H→0 stays split exact after tensoring. Dimension additivity gives b≤k and dimension H=k-b, hence each free piece has rank k-b.

The affine quasi-coherent equivalence identifies the split quotient H with the sheaf cokernel of im f→ker g [lem-weil-pbc-affine-tilde-gamma-adjunction, lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-module-cokernel-image]. The universal properties identify this cokernel with short-complex homology. Restriction to an open subscheme is exact, as can be checked on stalks, and preserves homology; hence these local free quotient sheaves are the restrictions of S.homology. The resulting neighbourhoods cover Z, so finite local freeness of rank k-b follows [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. For empty Z the condition is vacuous.

theorem isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_homology_of_locally_split_image
    {Z : Scheme.{u}} (S : ShortComplex Z.Modules) (k b : ℕ)
    (hkernel : (kernel S.g).IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank k)
    (himage : (Abelian.image S.f).IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank b)
    (hsplit : ∀ z : Z, ∃ U : Z.Opens, z ∈ U ∧
      IsSplitMono ((restrictFunctor U.ι).map (Abelian.image.ι S.f))) :
    S.homology.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank (k - b)
